a2a2a_message.action_requested: Create AI Backend Service (services/ai-backend/) — FastAPI from Scratch

context.goal:
services/ai-backend/ DOES NOT EXIST (verified). Create a complete FastAPI backend service with the following structure:

services/ai-backend/

  requirements.txt       — fastapi, uvicorn, httpx, pydantic, pydantic-settings

  README.md              — Setup + run instructions
